description: This file contains extension methods for IServiceCollection to register and manage content parts, content fields, and their handlers within the OrchardCore CMS framework.

classes.name: ServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: Static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to facilitate registration and configuration of content parts, fields, and handlers.

methods.name: AddContentPart
methods.description: Registers a content part type, allowing multiple calls for reconfiguration.

methods.name: AddContentField
methods.description: Registers a content field type, allowing multiple calls for reconfiguration.

methods.name: AddHandler (for content parts)
methods.description: Registers a handler for use with a content part.

methods.name: AddHandler (by type for content parts)
methods.description: Registers a handler type for a content part.

methods.name: RemoveHandler (for content parts)
methods.description: Removes a handler registration from a content part.

methods.name: RemoveHandler (by type for content parts)
methods.description: Removes a handler type from a content part.

methods.name: AddHandler (for content fields)
methods.description: Registers a handler for use with a content field.

methods.name: AddHandler (by type for content fields)
methods.description: Registers a handler type for a content field.

methods.name: RemoveHandler (for content fields)
methods.description: Removes a handler registration from a content field.

methods.name: RemoveHandler (by type for content fields)
methods.description: Removes a handler type from a content field.
